description: Ex-RAF Lightning T.4 XM992, supplied to the RSAF in 1966 as 54-651, later 54-608 (thunder-and-lightnings.co.uk; Lightning Association). Pylon-mounted on the traffic circle outside the Prince Sultan Air Base main gate, painted as 486 in RSAF markings; the base welcome inscription is on the plinth. Photographed 12 Sep 2023 (Wikimedia Commons, two-seat canopy visible, code 486 in Arabic and Latin numerals). Identity 54-608 is from the survivor lists, not from the paint.
museum_name: Prince Sultan Air Base Gate Roundabout Lightning
